note: Machine-readable source of truth for the HLB acquiring chain. scripts/validate-test-data.py derives its ENDPOINTS/ENUMS from this file; references/acquiring-hlb-profile.md is the human-facing view. This document is customer-identified (HLB) and is intentionally kept out of any generic publish package.

special.90天剔除3天: within 90 days, excluding the most recent 3 days
special.24小时剔除3天: within 24 hours, excluding the most recent 3 days

isolation.rule: Isolate every key used by the indicator; do not run cases concurrently when any relevant key is shared.

field_mapping_notes.bank_card_number: only AcqAuthorization requires paymentinstrumentid (C_S_PAYMENTINSTRUMENTID); AcqModify/AcqDisputes do not carry card numbers

known_issues.title: Field Mapping Mismatch
known_issues.problem: userdata12 in AcqModify/AcqDisputes maps to C_F_TRANSACTIONAMOUNT, not C_F_ORIGINALTRXNAMOUNT
known_issues.impact: Chargeback ratio metrics incorrect if using ORIGINALTRXNAMOUNT

known_issues.title: Enum Value Mismatch
known_issues.problem: Card scheme enum only accepts V/M, not VISA/MasterCard
known_issues.impact: Test data with VISA/MasterCard fails enum validation
known_issues.solution: Use V for Visa, M for MasterCard

known_issues.title: AcqAuthorization Encoding
known_issues.problem: AcqAuthorization requires JSON encoding, not form encoding
known_issues.impact: Test data with form encoding fails
known_issues.solution: Use application/json content-type for AcqAuthorization interface
